rule.name: py/sql-injection
rule.description: User-controlled data flows to a SQL query
rule.full_description: User-controlled data is used to construct a SQL query without proper sanitization. An attacker can inject arbitrary SQL syntax and exfiltrate or modify data.

message.text: This SQL query depends on a user-controlled value from request.args.get('search').

_meta.expected_reason: SQL injection in production code path, reachable from HTTP layer
